data.title: Lime Gardens
data.about:
Lime Gardens is a unique premium residential complex by developer Emaar, located in the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate. The project is a true embodiment of style, comfort and modern design. The 23-storey high building, designed in a laconic urban style, admires its elegance and modern approach to architecture.

Lime Gardens Residences feature a variety of floor plans including 1 to 3 bedroom apartments and a limited collection of 9 two-story, two-bedroom townhouses. All units feature floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows and spacious terraces offering stunning views of the park and picturesque greenery.

The infrastructure of Lime Gardens impresses with its variety of opportunities for recreation and active pastime. The complex features adult and children's pools, an event hall, landscaped gardens and lawns, a state-of-the-art gym and retail stores on the basement level. Here every resident will find a place to enjoy comfort, luxury and impeccable service. Lime Gardens is conveniently located just 5 minutes from Dubai Hills Mall and 10-20 minutes drive from many popular areas and locations in Dubai such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport, Dubai Motor City, Business Bay, Dubai Sports City, Dubai Motor City and DIFC.
